title: Multiplayer parallel repetition without dependency-breaking and anchoring variables: monotonic, concave amplification
summary: We obtain quantitative estimates on the decay of the multiplayer optimal value under parallel repetition. In comparison to a previous work of the author in 2025 (arXiv: 2508.09380) which sought to generalize dependency-breaking and anchoring variables from two-player Quantum games, being able to establish quantitative estimates on the decay of the optimal value of a multiplayer game under parallel repetition is of interest to establish under different assumptions.
